names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 8 iulie, «Sfântul Cuvios Teofil, Izvorâtorul de mir», with the rank words left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 8 Ιουλίου, «Όσιος Θεόφιλος ο Αγιορείτης», with the rank word and the epithet left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 8. јул ст. ст., „Преп. Теофил мироточиви“ — „Преп.“ is the rank and comes off, and „мироточиви“ is **kept**, because it is a by-name standing directly on the name, has no `types` word behind it anywhere in the vocabulary, and is the very thing this corpus’s display name renders as «the Myrrh-streamer»: it distinguishes him and does not grade him. It is printed lower-case in the heading and is copied that way. `foldchk.py` returns NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM for both «Теофил мироточиви» and the bare «Теофил», so **the choice was made on the rule and not on the fold** — and it is the exact opposite of the two Procopii of this same day, where what would have broken a real fold was a rank and had to come off.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and is plainly the same man: an Athonite of the monastery of Pantokrator whose verses on the page call him Μυροβλύτα, the myrrh-gusher, which is the folder's own epithet. It heads him «(1460 - 1548)» and says he was born at Zichne in Macedonia about 1460; those years are reported rather than written, because the folder's `dates` come from doxologia and this reader did not compare them. His right hand, it says, is incorrupt and in the shape of a blessing at the monastery of Pantokrator on the Holy Mountain. The page prints hymns, but the extractor cut it in the middle and no hymn was read whole, so none is taken. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 21.07.2026 (8. јул ст. ст.) — „Преп. Теофил мироточиви“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. The Julian 8 July is the same menologion number this folder’s other venerated row or rows carry, so there is no second day and no §4 note is owed. **`dates` UNTOUCHED, AND THE AGREEMENT IS TO THE DAY.** The folder holds `death` 1548 to 1548 `attested` off doxologia, «Când sfântul a trecut la Domnul pe 8 iulie 1548…». This book ends „Упокоји се 8 јула 1548 год.“ — **the same day and the same year**. Two books, one date, nothing to widen and nothing to add: the field is passed back verbatim, note and all, and this is the second folder of this range whose `dates` the Prologue confirms to the day, after `cyprian-the-new-martyr` on 5 July. saint.gr’s «born at Zichne in Macedonia about 1460» was never written into this folder and is not written now. **THIS ENTRY MOSTLY AGREES, AND THE AGREEMENT IS THE FINDING — EXCEPT IN ONE SENTENCE, WHERE IT ANSWERS A QUESTION THE OTHER PAGE LEAVES OPEN.** The folder already has Macedonia and the village of Ziki, the learning, the commission from the patriarch Niphon of Constantinople, the journey to Alexandria about the patriarch Joachim «that he could move mountains and drink poison without harm», Vatopedi and Iviron and the cell of Saint Basil near Karyes, the refusal of the throne of Thessalonica out of humility, the order to his disciple Isaac to tie a rope round his feet and throw his body into the stream, and the finding of the relics and the myrrh. **And the folder’s own life says of the Alexandrian errand: «The page does not say what he found.»** This book says it: „Уверивши се у истинитост ових чудеса Теофил се врати у Св. Гору“ — having satisfied himself of the **truth** of those wonders, Theophilus returned to the Holy Mountain. That is written into the life, and it is the one thing on this day that fills a hole another book left open rather than adding beside it. **AND ONE MORE THING NEITHER OTHER BOOK HAS: WHO PUT JOACHIM TO THE TEST.** „нагнан на ово од јевреја и муслимана“ — he was driven to it by Jews and Muslims. Written into the life as the book has it. `types` UNTOUCHED: `venerable` and `monk` are both there and „Преп.“ is the `venerable`. **`wonderworker` and `hymnographer` and every other rank are refused**, and so is anything off „мироточиви“: the myrrh-streaming is in the heading as the by-name this corpus already renders «the Myrrh-streamer» in the display name, **and there is no `types` word for it in the vocabulary at all**, so nothing is written either way. **NO `office`, AND THE SEE IN THIS ENTRY IS ONE HE REFUSED**: „Понуду да се прими за архиепископа Солунског овај свети човек одбије“ — he declined the offer of the archbishopric of Thessalonica. A see a man refused is not his office, and `office` strings are not invented in any case. No `locations`: Macedonia, a village, Alexandria, two monasteries and a cell in a narrative are not coordinates. **NO ROWS.** The folder relates nobody and this book gives it nobody. `niphon-patriarch-of-constantinople`, whose display name is the bare «Niphon», is the patriarch who sent him on the errand — **and takes no row**: a commission is not a kinship, and an identification made off a name in another man’s life is not an identification. `joachim-i-pany-of-alexandria` exists and **takes no row** on the same ground doubled: the man whose wonders an entry exists to have investigated is the object of the errand and not a companion, and the match is again off a name. The disciple Isaac takes no row, «Isaac» being the bare display name of two folders of that name and neither of them this man. **All three names are written in the prose**, because the folder’s own older prose already names all three and `npm test` passes on it — they are not new strings this reading introduces. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse. **THE DAY’S TWO PROCOPII FOLD ONTO EACH OTHER, AND THAT IS MEASURED AND FORCED.** Entry 1 is „Св. вел. муч. Прокопије“ and entry 2 is „Св. Прокопије Јуродиви“. Свети is not a rank; „вел. муч.“ is the great-martyr; and **„Јуродиви“ is a rank too** — §5 lists Христа ради јуродиви / Јуродиви as `fool-for-christ`, which is a `types` word and not a by-name. So both headings reduce to the bare «Прокопије», and the two folders this day writes take the same `sr` form. `foldchk.py` returns `procopius-of-sazava`, `sr`, for that string, so after this day **three folders hold it**, two of them written on one day. **This is the 18 June case with the answer going the other way**: there both entries were a Leontius and keeping „прозорљиви“ was the only reason the day’s two folders did not fold together — but that word is a by-name with no `types` behind it, where „Јуродиви“ is the rank the folder already carries. A rank may not be kept in a form to break a fold. «Прокопије Јуродиви» was measured and holds nobody, and was refused on the rule; „Устјужски“, which would also have broken it, stands in the **body** and a by-name is kept only where the heading itself gives one. The three are told apart by their display names, their `types` and their days: a `great-martyr` and `soldier` of Caesarea on 8 July, a `fool-for-christ` and `wonderworker` of Ustyug on 8 July, and the Bohemian abbot of Sázava.
